descriptionFull: The eastern whip-poor-will ( Antrostomus vociferus ) is a medium-sized (22–27 cm) nightjar from North America. The whip-poor-will is commonly heard within its range, but less often seen because of its camouflage. It is named onomatopoeically after its song.
